body:
Ordinary Recorder discovery rejected an observed approximately one-second valid reply with its 0.75-second default. The advertisement endpoint also requested fresh Federation authority, so an unavailable voter could delay even public routing metadata. These are the two sides of the discovery startup boundary.

Read existing local routing metadata through bounded, read-only database connections without constructing a writable coordinator or requesting quorum. The advertisement keeps its public field allowlist and is never a grant, proof of leadership or membership. Grant issuance still requires verified real tailnet peers and the existing application authority/fresh quorum; discovery cannot create membership or bypass a one-use grant.

Allow two seconds per complete HTTP exchange, with at most eight concurrent peers, 32 peers and four configured ports. All probes share a ten-second deadline after the existing two-second Tailscale command budget. Direct numeric-host HTTP avoids redirects, proxies and DNS; absolute socket deadlines bound trickled headers and bodies. An exhausted scan fails closed rather than returning a partial unique Federation. Saved membership retains its existing restart path.

Validation: focused boundary tests cover actual delayed and trickled HTTP, malformed and ambiguous replies, bounded peer/port exhaustion, ordinary Recorder denial without a grant, saved membership preservation, public metadata without quorum, and unchanged real quorum failure for grant creation. The primary run had 171 passes and two native Windows fixture/environment failures; both passed after a portable path assertion and child-only qualified Python PATH correction. Follow-up tests include the new header-trickle and ordinary Recorder exhaustion cases. Ruff and diff hygiene pass. These are focused regressions, not release qualification. The boundary tests are included in the existing Windows/Linux release jobs.

PR #456 separately repairs the POSIX launcher following a readiness redirect into stateful login rendering. The defects are independently testable; no consensus or grant-authority behavior is weakened by either PR. No repair is deployed. Physical acceptance remains stopped until exact PR HEAD qualification, normal merges, actual final merged-main qualification, and checked-in revalidation against 0536f03d67eb277e11573c2188d8e820399627e3. Protected Recorder data is untouched.
